subject: Change request: GreenFrame Order Form GF-778 — scope scrub & redline plan
messages:
From: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@greenframe.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenframe.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Change request: Order Form GF-778 - scope realignment

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the onboarding session last week. After a review with engineering and procurement, we need to propose a change to the current Order Form GF-778. Two main asks:

1) Remove the SOW tasks related to custom NER model training (Tasks 4.1–4.3). We will postpone that to a later phase.
2) Reallocate the committed throughput (from 8k to 6k throughput units) and reduce the monthly fee proportionally; procurement is asking for a price adjustment that reflects the lower committed capacity.

I attached a short summary (GF-Change-Request.pdf). Can you confirm next steps for redlines and whether you require a mutual action plan to proceed?

We would like legal and procurement alignment this week if possible — does Redwood have a standard amendment template?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lowe
Head of Platform Operations
GreenFrame Labs

Attachment: GF-Change-Request.pdf (1 page, PDF summary)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@greenframe.com>, procurement@greenframe.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change request: Order Form GF-778 - scope realignment

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. We can support a scope carve and a matching Order Form amendment. High-level next steps from our side:

- I'll loop in our account lead (Monica) and our contracts counsel (Laura) so we can produce a tracked redline and a short mutual action plan (MAP).
- Please confirm whether the throughput change is intended to be permanent or a phased reduction (e.g., drop to 6k for quarter, then re-evaluate). That affects billing/proration and the fee calculation.
- If you want, we can run a brief commercial concession review — our standard threshold for price concessions tied to committed reductions sits with me, but anything beyond 15% of committed value will require manager approval.

I'll aim to get a MAP draft and a redline summary into your inbox by end of day tomorrow. Laura — can you advise on any pre-approved amendment templates we should start from? Monica — can you prepare a quick pricing delta (monthly run rate change) based on a 6k commit so we can share a number back to procurement?

Thanks — talk soon.

— Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0198

Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft MAP and commercial delta for GF-778

Hi all — following up with the draft mutual action plan and an initial commercial delta.

Summary (quick):
- Scope: Drop SOW Tasks 4.1–4.3 (custom NER training) from current Phase 1 scope; keep integration and monitoring work intact.
- Throughput: Commit moves from 8k -> 6k throughput units (ongoing).
- Commercial impact: Estimated recurring fee reduction of ~18% on the implementation + monthly committed fee (see attached GF-Amendment-term-sheet.xlsx for line-level math).
- Timeline: We can produce an amendment and redline within 3 business days after legal flags. If GreenFrame approves the delta, next steps are: Redwood produces tracked redline, GreenFrame reviews, then DocuSign.

Laura — flagging the estimated 18% concession. If commercial is OK with that, is there a preferred clause language you want us to include for the SOW carve and throughput repricing (proration, early re-up credits, rollback guardrails)?

Sarah — can you confirm procurement's target decision date so we can align signatory routing?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-greenframe-draft.md, GF-Amendment-term-sheet.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@greenframe.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and commercial delta for GF-778 — redline guidance

Thanks for the context. Quick legal guidance and recommended language:

1) Amendment structure: We should do a single amendment document that: (a) adds Exhibit X for the SOW carve (explicitly listing removed tasks and reassigning schedule items), and (b) updates Order Form pricing table with the new committed throughput and a revised fee schedule.

2) Proration & credits: Proposed clause — proration for the month of change; if Customer re-ups to higher commit within 90 days, provide a one-time re-up credit equal to the difference in unit price for the remainder of month of switch (protects Customer while preventing churn gaming).

3) Quality/reliance: For removed SOW items, add a short acceptance clause noting any deliverables already finished remain billable; for work not started, those tasks will be re-scoped as a future SOW.

4) Approval routing: If commercial concession >15% of total committed ARR, legal needs Exec approval for concession. Monica has indicated ~18% — please confirm final number.

I'll produce a redline_summary.docx with the tracked language and a clean amendment template for signature. Recommend we schedule a 30-min sync with procurement to walk the redline before we send to DocuSign.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_summary.docx

- Monica — the 18% estimate is within our approval band but I need to confirm manager ok; please hold the amendment in draft until I get sign-off (I will confirm by EOD tomorrow).

- Sarah / GreenFrame — can we schedule a 30-minute redline walk-through Thursday morning (our calendar shows availability 09:00–11:00 PT)? If that works I will send a calendar invite and include your procurement lead Alex.

We'll aim to keep the change order lean — carve the three tasks, apply 6k throughput pricing, proration clause as suggested, and include the 90-day re-up credit. Once I have internal approval I'll authorise sending to DocuSign.

— Karthik
